description: Creates the order in the Orders table for one order file that was uploaded to Order Desk's Orders folder, and gives back the order number. It keeps the PO number, the delivery date and the delivery address as the order states them. If that file was registered before, it returns the same order instead of making a second one. Uses no AI.
